name: Authority-Bounded Q&A (world-vs-instance trap)
source_contract: Statute/case excerpt, modified so the real-world rule differs — TO BE SOURCED + PERTURBED
provenance: Modified authority excerpt; the real-world rule deliberately differs (contamination trap). Provisional; excerpt to be sourced.

criteria.criterion: Answers from the excerpt as printed; does not import the real-world rule where it contradicts the excerpt
Cites no authority not present in the excerpt
Identifies the controlling provision in the excerpt and applies it to the question
Application of the excerpt's (modified) rule is internally correct
Clear answer grounded in the excerpt with the operative language cited

trips_on: Answering with the real-world legal rule where it contradicts the modified excerpt
Citing authority not present in the excerpt
does_not_trip_on: Noting that the excerpt's rule differs from the general rule while still answering from the excerpt
True background context not used to override the excerpt

rubric_markdown:
GRADER INSTRUCTIONS — B4 (Authority-Bounded Q&A (world-vs-instance trap)) · Max /12 · Gates: Faithfulness
ROLE: Grade the model's response against this gold rubric. Do NOT solve the task yourself. For every sub-judgment, quote the exact span of the response you relied on; a judgment with no quotable evidence scores 0. Return structured JSON per the Tier 1 template (Section 6.5). Never show this block to the model.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: Answer ONLY from the excerpt as printed; the excerpt's rule has been modified so it differs from the real-world rule — the modified rule governs. Importing the real rule where it contradicts the excerpt is the trap.
SCORING (v8 — weighted ratio): each dimension score = Σ(weight×verdict)/Σ(weight), weights critical=3/major=2/minor=1, verdict met=1/partial=0.5/not_met=0/n-a=excluded. Assign a verdict to EACH listed criterion; never assign the dimension number yourself.
FAITHFULNESS /3 (GATE): criteria — [critical, B4.trap.no_world_override] Answers from the excerpt as printed; does not import the real-world rule where it contradicts the excerpt; [critical] Cites no authority not present in the excerpt. TRIPS ONLY ON: Answering with the real-world legal rule where it contradicts the modified excerpt; Citing authority not present in the excerpt. DOES NOT TRIP ON: Noting that the excerpt's rule differs from the general rule while still answering from the excerpt; True background context not used to override the excerpt.
COVERAGE /4: criteria — [critical, B4.authority.controlling_provision] Identifies the controlling provision in the excerpt and applies it to the question.
SOUNDNESS /3: criteria — [critical] Application of the excerpt's (modified) rule is internally correct.
ACTIONABILITY /2: criteria — [critical] Clear answer grounded in the excerpt with the operative language cited.
DISCRETION VALVE (v8): if a response is not addressed by the enumerated gate conditions, return verdict not_covered on that gate (routes to human-confirm) + a proposed_condition stating the rule that would resolve it — do NOT guess trip/pass.
PROCEDURE: assign a verdict to every criterion → weighted ratio per dimension → raw = Σ max(dim)×ratio → normalize to /12 → if ANY gate tripped, cap the normalized score at 0.40 and flag it.
